I replied in #north-team, in the thread on Dana's question. There is no settled seat count for the 2026 renewal in any signed document. The renewal order form doesn't state one. The account page shows 185 active seats, and Amendment No. 3 sets 230 seats from 2027-01-01. Ilse's 261 is only a message in the channel, not a signed figure, so I suggested Dana use 185 for now and 230 from 2027-01-01 until someone confirms otherwise.

My first reply said Ilse's message was from today. It was from 2026-10-14, so I posted a correction in the thread.
